stances.summary: Says she has been holding the administration accountable for "lawless ICE and CBP actions."

sources.title: Washington State Voters' Pamphlet 2026 (candidate statement)
sources.quote: I’ve been on the frontlines of holding Trump accountable, including around the lawless ICE and CBP actions that have kidnapped and disappeared our neighbors.

stances.summary: Is leading the fight for the Medicare for All Act.

sources.title: Washington State Voters' Pamphlet 2026 (candidate statement)
sources.quote: I’m leading the fight for the Medicare for All Act to ensure that universal healthcare is a right, not a privilege.

stances.summary: Says the health system should be restructured to create a path to single-payer like Medicare for All.

sources.title: Washington State Voters' Pamphlet 2026 (candidate statement)
sources.quote: Our healthcare system needs to be restructured to create a path to a single-payer plan like Medicare for All.

stances.summary: Leads legislation to establish an ultra-millionaire wealth tax.

sources.title: Washington State Voters' Pamphlet 2026 (candidate statement)
sources.quote: I also lead landmark legislation to make higher education tuitionfree, guarantee housing as a human right, expand workers’ rights, raise the federal minimum wage, implement humane immigration reform, and establish an ultra-millionaire wealth tax.

stances.summary: Leads bipartisan bills to ban stock trading by members of Congress.

sources.title: Washington State Voters' Pamphlet 2026 (candidate statement)
sources.quote: I lead bipartisan bills that ban stock trading for Members of Congress and protect Americans from government spying.

stances.summary: Says the Climate Commitment Act is driving up energy costs while doing little for the environment.

sources.title: Washington State Voters' Pamphlet 2026 (candidate statement)
sources.quote: The Climate Commitment Act may sound good, but in practice it is driving up the cost of energy while doing little to directly improve the environment.

stances.summary: Championed the millionaires tax in the Legislature.

sources.title: Washington State Voters' Pamphlet 2026 (candidate statement)
sources.quote: I earned positions in Democratic leadership and on tax and budget committees to champion the millionaires tax, which funds education, expands healthcare access, and cuts taxes for working families.

stances.summary: Fought to pass tenant protections including rent stabilization.

sources.title: Washington State Voters' Pamphlet 2026 (candidate statement)
sources.quote: I battled the landlord lobby to pass tenant protections like rent stabilization and reformed zoning laws to increase home building.
